failure_rules: Unsupported CPU/OS ISA is explicit not-covered, never a successful substitute scalar run.
Wrong globals, renamed code/relocation discrepancy, stale/missing new R receipt or failed ELF association stops before execution.
Any pure guard false stops before that raw call; any signal, timeout, unexpected input/output mutation or full-word mismatch is failure, preserved without filtering/refitting/retry.
Numerical refusal represented in output is compared in full, never dropped or converted to a harness pass/fail assumption about valid flags.
